note: The flagship assets of each issuer, best first. With no filter and no search, the Assets list opens on these: the first of every issuer, then the second of every issuer, and so on, five deep, with every other asset after them in A to Z order. Issuers appear in the order they are written here. An issuer missing from this file contributes its five largest assets by supply, or its first five in assets.json.
